- Cytra-Syncmatica is now Alloy Syncmatica, with the new Alloy logo
- Server hardening: uploaded schematic previews are size-checked, chunk claims only accept the server's real dimensions, and the claim list is sent in bounded parts

mods.name: Cytra Creative
mods.changelog: Every lab now has its own Nether, linked by portals. Mobs spawn in labs, rejoining a lab no longer leaves a ghost player, and labs follow the server's /tick like any dimension.

mods.name: Cytra Hub
mods.changelog:
- New mod pages: Cytra Map, Cytra Printer, Cytra Shulker View and Cytra Ledger (ops)
- Changelogs for every Cytra mod are up to date
- HUD editor: the panel no longer stays on top of the element you drag when other mods' HUD elements fill the corners

mods.name: Cytra Ledger
mods.changelog: Server-only player action log (/ll). New: /ll wand gives the Ledger Wand - hold it and click blocks, containers or entities to see their history; right-click the air for what happened nearby.

mods.name: Cytra Link
mods.changelog: Bots may send larger messages once connected (up to 8 MB), so areas sent to labs travel fast.

mods.name: Cytra Map
mods.changelog: First release: Cytra's own minimap and world map. Cave and Nether layers, markers with custom pictures, Classic (Xaero-like) style, biome and height views, chat coordinate links, Litematica boxes, Xaero map import and an optional shared server map.

mods.name: Cytra Mass Craft
mods.changelog: No dump containers: results are now crafted and dropped in one click, no pause before they drop.

mods.name: Cytra Printer
mods.changelog: First release: a fast Litematica printer that only places a block when vanilla placement would give exactly the schematic's block and rotation. Fixes wrong blocks, waits for the server, safe redstone order. Works in survival and creative; the same jar on the server makes placement even more exact.

mods.name: Cytra Send
mods.changelog: First release: the SMP side of Cytra Creative labs. Select an area (/cc send wand, or pos1/pos2) and run /cc send <name>; the bridge bot carries it to the CMP, where it becomes a lab with a [Go to lab] button. Up to 1024x1024, every height, unloaded chunks too.

mods.name: Cytra Shulker View
mods.changelog: Fix: labels on placed shulkers now show with Optimized Block Entities (they only flashed while opening).

mods.name: StickyToggle
mods.changelog: New Alloy logo as the mod icon.
